purpose: Compact anonymous result evidence; frozen saved scores and reports, not model predictions or resumable fitting outputs.
numerical_policy: Numerical scientific values are preserved; identity fields and scheduler details are redacted. Original hashes refer to private originals; exported hashes verify shipped evidence.
excluded: Raw corpora, vectors, PCA arrays, model/checkpoint files, scheduler logs, obsolete protocol proposals, historical manuscript, trial-level fits and original executable source manifests.
